mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing triamcinolone plasma concentrations and glucocorticoid effects, while triamcinolone may induce CYP3A4 metabolism of erythromycin.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, adrenal suppression); consider alternative antibiotic or dose adjustment of triamcinolone if prolonged erythromycin use required.
